items.title: Autistic Techie
items.description: An autistic-led podcast hosted by tech lead Shea Belsky about workplace self-advocacy and neurodivergent careers.

items.title: Work Strategy for Autistic Adults
items.description: A practical guide to identifying work conditions, communication needs, and adjustments that make a role more sustainable.

items.title: Unleash Your ADHD
items.description: Coaching and practical resources for founders and senior leaders with ADHD, informed by lived experience.

items.title: Bjièn: Neurodiversity at Work
items.description: Neuro-inclusion training, workshops, and resources from a team founded by autistic ADHDers.

items.title: Disability:IN Neurodiversity Roundtable
items.description: An employer network for sharing practices and resources that support neurodivergent employees.

items.title: Association for Autism and Neurodiversity
items.description: Community, education, and support for autistic and similarly neurodivergent people, their families, and professionals.

items.title: ND Connect
items.description: A neurodivergent-led community offering peer support, mentorship, events, and virtual body doubling.

items.title: Neurodiverse Hackers
items.description: A neurodivergent-led nonprofit community supporting people in cybersecurity.

items.title: Professionally Neurospicy
items.description: A neurodivergent-founded peer-support community for professionals navigating work life unmasked.

items.title: Autistic Self Advocacy Network
items.description: An autistic-led advocacy organization offering resources, policy work, and opportunities to take action.

items.title: NeuroClastic
items.description: An autistic-led nonprofit publishing free, accessible articles and resources by autistic writers.

items.title: Diversify Tech
items.description: Jobs, events, scholarships, and other career opportunities for underrepresented people in tech.

items.title: Jobs for Humanity: Neurodivergent Job Listings
items.description: Job opportunities and employment resources for neurodivergent candidates.

items.title: Mentra
items.description: A career network that connects neurodivergent job seekers with inclusive employers.
